searchText: MSRP $281,146. The All-New 2027 Entegra Coach Vision XL 36C Class A Luxury RV for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Optional Features Coastal Decor Texas Paint Customer Value Package 5.5 KW generator 50 amp electrical service 1,200 watt inverter Automatic hydraulic leveling jacks Backup and sideview camera Driver/passenger cockpit table Electric awning with LED lights Exterior entertainment center with LED TV and single disc DVD/FM radio Frameless windows Infotainment system E-Z Drive Elite package LED TV in living room Roller shades Slideout cover awnings Solid-surface kitchen countertops Front Overhead Bunk  The Entegra Coach Vision XL is built for your next adventure and includes all new features such as new exterior graphics package, all new full body paint exteriors, infotainment center changed to Sony w/apple car play and android auto, solid surface counters upgraded to match in bathroom and bedroom. This beautiful RV features automatic hydraulic leveling jacks, Ford chassis. The Vision XL's impressive list of standard features that truly set it apart from the competition include Entegra's unparalleled 2 year warranty, one-piece fiberglass front cap, panoramic windshield with power shade, seamless crowned fiberglass roof, ball-bearing drawer guides, large shower and much more. New for 2027 includes new graphics and paint options, lowering the shower pan height where possible, dovetail drawer boxes, LED headlights, fabric sofa/theater option and dune gray painted cabinets or optional coastal decor wood.
